subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the active Anthropic transport/header path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open fork PR uses closing syntax and is currently conflicting, so automation should not queue a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
options.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition path with regression coverage for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Bring the fork change forward, update it for current direct transport behavior, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait on the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
recommendation.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition path with regression coverage for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current active header path and wrapper activation blame most directly point to Vincent Koc in the available checkout history.
